Fetched 8 planned URLs via python urllib (bash `curl` unavailable in loop shell; used option 2 from source-access.md: retrieve body in code, write verbatim to path). All 200 OK.
parse exit 3 (more pages). Paged _plan_next.tsv 3x (s200, s400).
parse exit 0 COMPLETE. files_read=10 distinct_providers=777 location_rows=1188. No exit-4 ceiling truncation. empty_responses=2 (Pediatric Anesthesiology zip3 283 and 295 = zero records).

parse flagged shared practice addresses: 171 ASHLEY AVE Charleston (106 individuals), 2095 HENRY TECKLENBURG DR (65), 169 ASHLEY AVE RM 202 (52) - employer/billing addresses, all outside 50mi ring anyway.
geo_filter.py filter -> in 1188 rows, kept 72 (deduped by npi, nearest site), outside 1098, unplaceable_zip 14 DROPPED (coverage loss). 4 extra practice locations collapsed.
NPI-2 sweep by zip3 284/294/295 hit parse exit 4 = registry ceiling ~1200/query. Count NOT a total. Partitioned further per skill instruction.
Re-planned NPI-2 sweep across the 16 exact 5-digit ZIPs present in near.csv; paged 3 rounds; parse exit 0 COMPLETE, 2961 organizations, 4186 location rows.
npi_query.py employers -> 2688 org addresses indexed from 25 files; 60/72 rows (83%) have an org at their address; 42 (58%) have a specialty-matching top candidate.

Registry peds signal inside ring = 0. Zero of 72 carry Pediatric Anesthesiology (207LP3000X) or any pediatric taxonomy - exactly the failure mode SKILL.md predicts. Peds capability must come from enrichment, not the registry.

WebSearch UNAVAILABLE: session-wide budget exhausted (200/200 WebSearch calls used before this run). Org-site discovery by search is impossible. Falling back to direct WebFetch of guessed canonical URLs + PubMed E-utilities.
conwaymedicalcenter.com/find-a-provider/?specialty=Anesthesiology -> 404 retired page, NO_RECORDS (rung 2 fail).
tidelandshealth.org/find-a-doctor -> HTTP 403 Forbidden. Bot fingerprinting wall. Rung 4 (browser) prohibited under CONDITION A. Recorded UNREADABLE.
ambulatorycareanesthesia.com -> DNS ENOTFOUND. No site at guessed domain; cannot discover real domain without WebSearch (budget exhausted). UNREADABLE.
conwaymedicalcenter.com/providers/ -> readable, 1 anesthesiology provider named: Ihor Melnytskyy MD ABANES. No emails, no peds mention.
grandstrandmed.com 301 -> mygrandstrandhealth.com; followed per source-access.md (redirect is not a wall).
mygrandstrandhealth.com/physicians?specialty=Anesthesiology -> 200, 'Loading doctors', zero names = JavaScript shell. Rung 3 (endpoint discovery) NOT attempted - timebox. Recorded UNREADABLE.
PubMed E-utilities esearch+efetch for all 72 providers: 48 had author hits, 24 none. 8 candidate emails extracted.

All 8 PubMed emails REJECTED as author-name collisions - domains are uscupstate.edu, charlotte.edu, lsuhsc.edu, utoronto.ca, iastate.edu, clin.au.dk, gmail, ehmchealth.org: none belong to a Myrtle Beach-area practice. email-tradecraft.md: shared name => at most one address can be right => not emittable. Zero emails emitted.
PubMed peds keyword hits (30) also rejected: author query was not affiliation-locked, so the peds signal is not attributable to these individuals. Not used for confidence.

email_pattern.py learn/apply NOT run: zero observed addresses at any employer domain, so evidence.csv would be empty. email-tradecraft.md: 'Stop guessing entirely when fewer than two observed addresses at the domain.' No derived addresses produced.
Territory computed by haversine from Census ZIP centroid to Myrtle Beach vs Greenville SC. All 72 -> Myrtle Beach (max 46.2mi to MB; nearest to Greenville is 184.3mi). Zero Greenville.

Wrote result.csv (72 rows, 28 cols, per-field source columns + email confidence label), report.md (brief per SKILL.md section order), meta.json.
